title: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 66 (Waste by mortgagor in possession)

content.overview: A mortgagor in possession may manage the property as a person of ordinary prudence, but must not commit waste that renders the security insufficient.
content.glance: A mortgagor in possession may manage the property as a person of ordinary prudence, but must not commit waste that renders the security insufficient.
